definitions.gloss: price revision; price adjustment; price change
definitions.explanation: An official change in the price of products or services. A business euphemism that often means a price increase, though it can refer to either direction.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}から{価格改定|かかくかいてい}を{行|おこな}います。
examples.english: We will implement a price revision starting next month.

examples.japanese: {原材料費|げんざいりょうひ}の{高騰|こうとう}により{価格改定|かかくかいてい}のお{知|し}らせ。
examples.english: Notice of price revision due to rising raw material costs.

examples.japanese: {度重|たびかさ}なる{価格改定|かかくかいてい}に{消費者|しょうひしゃ}の{不満|ふまん}が{高|たか}まっている。
examples.english: Consumer dissatisfaction is growing over repeated price revisions.

notes: Composed of {価格|かかく} (price) + {改定|かいてい} (revision, amendment). In practice, {価格改定|かかくかいてい} almost always refers to a price increase — companies use this softer term instead of directly saying {値上|ねあ}げ (price hike). Common phrases: {価格改定|かかくかいてい}のお{知|し}らせ (notice of price revision), {価格改定|かかくかいてい}を{実施|じっし}する (to carry out a price revision). Related: {値上|ねあ}げ (price increase — more direct), {値下|ねさ}げ (price decrease).
